scenes.heading: Building a demo reel that gets you hired

sents.d: Building a demo reel that gets you hired
Lead with your best 10 seconds, not your most recent shoot.
A demo reel is a sales tool, not a highlight archive — most viewers decide whether to keep watching in the first 10 seconds, so open with your strongest single shot, not your most recent project.

Keep the full reel under 90 seconds, and consider building 2–3 versions targeted at different client types (e.g. a wedding-focused reel vs. a commercial/brand reel) rather than one reel trying to show everything you've ever shot.

scenes.heading: Cut work you don't want more of

sents.d: Cut anything that doesn't represent the work you want more of — showing a skill you don't enjoy just attracts more of that same work.

take: Your reel is a sales tool: short, focused, best shot first.
